reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the code generator incorrectly escapes the null character ('\0') as '\0' instead of '\000'. When a null character is followed by a digit (e.g., '\u00003'), the JavaScript parser interprets the sequence as an octal escape sequence rather than a null character followed by the digit '3'. This leads to incorrect string length and content, as evidenced by the failing test case and the provided bug report.
